count_guard.mechanism: Parsed entry count, identifier uniqueness, and rejection-family completeness

liveness_guard.mechanism: Lifecycle and supersession graph checks over every entry

tombstone_guard.mechanism: DII-003 reserves retired identifiers; mechanical non-remint enforcement is pending

count_guard.mechanism: Schema-backed exact keep, fold, and tombstone counts with byte-identical generated-view parity

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every kept action names a runtime binding and canonical lifecycle standing consumed by generated CLI, effect, and sensor views

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Every folded or tombstoned public path is never-reminted, resolves to migration guidance, and is rejected or redirected by the governed runtime surface

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every supported skill retains a registry consumer and executable entry

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Retired skill ids remain reserved with successor guidance

count_guard.mechanism: Explicit roster bijects with the canonical schema directory

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every roster schema retains a production validator, parser, or type consumer

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Archived predecessor schemas are segregated; successor tombstone enforcement is pending

count_guard.mechanism: Exact corpus count and per-record validation

liveness_guard.mechanism: Each record declares lifecycle; active-consumer and dormancy enforcement are pending

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Retired invariant ids remain reserved in a successor tombstone record

count_guard.mechanism: Active emitter-backed entries and archived compatibility dispositions are schema-backed and runtime-derived

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every active entry names an emitter, preserves cell or diagnostic standing, and resolves a successor-local design note

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Archived compatibility kinds retain explicit provenance, reason, replacement, and non-remint coverage

liveness_guard.mechanism: Record status and supersession fields validate; stale-active detection is pending

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Retired ADR ids remain reserved and resolve to successors

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every workflow retains a declared trigger and live script target

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Retired workflow identities remain in migration history

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every example builds and exercises a supported path

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Retired example ids remain documented with replacement guidance

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every page is reachable and free of stale currency claims

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Retired canonical pages preserve redirects or explicit successor pointers

count_guard.mechanism: Proof file growth is bounded by epoch and kind rather than execution count

liveness_guard.mechanism: Every open epoch closes into the chain with a terminal hash

tombstone_guard.mechanism: Proof records are never deleted; correction is an appended erratum bound by the chain
